Our Story

Seller Snap is a rapid growth SaaS startup, based in the heart of Tel Aviv. Established in 2017 with the vision of building the leading Amazon AI algorithmic repricing and analytics platform, we are constantly developing our product and finding the right talent to grow the Seller Snap team.
